status: fixed before any v2 forward; implementation level only; never changes a criterion, condition, prompt set, dose, site or statistic of research/cts_stage0_v2

layout.L2_steps: build_prefix: one unsteered forward of positions 0..L-2 (batch 1); score_from_prefix per condition: a fresh DynamicCache built from references to the prefix tensors, one forward of position L-1 (batch 1, position id L-1) with SuffixSteering, then the flat-packed continuation of all 104 forms (4D segment mask, position ids L + depth)
layout.prefix_reuse_safety: the prefix tensors are never modified in place (cache updates concatenate into new tensors); a digest test verifies immutability after use
layout.suffix_hook: adds the fp32 vector cast to the model dtype at the one position; refuses any forward whose hidden state is not [1, 1, H], whose position id or cache position differs from L-1, a second firing, and all-position rows
layout.own_prefix: PrefillSteering on a full prefill of positions 0..L-1 with one row (identical to the v1 L1 layout)
layout.logits: float32 F.linear(post-norm final state, lm_head weight); normalizer over all 152064 lm_head rows; form scores accumulated in float64

baselines.canonical: unsteered in L2, scored twice: baseline_rep1 (host group f) and baseline_rep2 (host group g); every per-form log-prob within 1e-4
baselines.own_prefix: persona:P_default, a registry condition scored in L1
baselines.sentinels: every score and re-score shard re-scores the L2 baseline on its first two prompts at start and end (<= 1e-4 against baseline_rep1)

plan.extraction_shards: personas in contract order, chunked so that personas x 1024 x extraction seconds x overhead <= 0.5 x retirement
plan.scoring_shards: one group per (registry group, cost class, prompt set), chunked by the same rule with the class seconds and the prompt-set size
plan.rescore_shards: flagged conditions by prompt set, chunked with the L1_reference seconds
plan.seconds_source: the contract's planning seconds (placeholders until the freeze fills TV-v2 measurements)

fragility.statistics: every statistic recorded by criteria.all_statistics whose conditions are all re-scored: TS b/c/e/f statistics (e uses point estimates, still standardized by SE_boot), PC (last position), PC_star, A4, A7, mention-label and BASE_SHARED_DIRECTION statistics of all three contrasts whether or not they pass (the checked set never depends on an outcome); m = 251 + 70 = 321
fragility.not_computable: A6 (persona contexts) and PC_pos (all positions) use own-prefix conditions, identical in L2 and L1
fragility.null_families: first 10 registry members of each of the 7 L2 null families; SD_F over all members of the family in L2
fragility.persisted: m, counts, RMS(z), max|z|, guard, verdict; no statistic

statistics.rank_test_ties: a null equal to T_obs counts as an exceedance
statistics.one_sided_bounds: type-7 quantiles of the paired replicates at alpha_TS and 1 - alpha_TS
statistics.SE_boot: numpy std ddof 1 of the 10,000 replicates
statistics.R_cov_rounding: the (199, 1024) Gaussian draw equals the first 199 rows of the v1 draw; the unit directions agree with the first 199 v1 directions to about 1e-15 (the matrix product's blocking depends on its shape); R_cov is generated once per run in the directions stage and stored with its hash

errors_and_retries.final_exit_86: every FinalFailure (identity, provenance, contract or input hash, guard, render, hook, cache, scoring, non-finite, statistics, sentinel, fragility, D/C leak, failed preflight) and every unclassified exception (software defect)
errors_and_retries.retryable: exit 1 (out of memory, operating-system I/O), 75 (SIGTERM), 85 (GPU unavailable); DAG RETRY 2 per node; no in-place rematch, so a shard has at most 3 attempts
errors_and_retries.attempt_events: start, success, integrity, refusal, software, infrastructure, sigterm; integrity reads every record

budget.unit: RemoteWallClockTime x RequestGpus / 3600 from condor_history (finished) and condor_q (running: accumulated wall time plus the current run), jobs identified by the job-ad attributes BsvBudgetCategory and BsvRunTag
budget.gate: PRE script of every DAG node (CPU nodes included, so the integrity node sees a current ledger): consumed + remaining projection of incomplete GPU shards <= cap, else BUDGET_STOP.json and exit 87 (ABORT-DAG-ON); every later PRE script and every job refuses
budget.complete_shards_for_projection: shards with a marker file (the integrity stage verifies markers fully)
budget.tv: category TV, cap 6 A100-h, a per-node remaining estimate of 1.5 A100-h per GPU node; attempts registered in the accounting root, at most 3

technical_validation.inputs: V prompts, P_default, the nonce persona, TV-seed random directions (seeds 1000001-1000004), the planted W_U[' zorb'] direction; S0 enters only as the multiset of rendered lengths of the 300 animal prompts (tokenizer only, 40 quantiles persisted)
technical_validation.length_matching: stand-in user prompts made of V words appended until the default rendering reaches each target length (within 2 tokens, gated)
technical_validation.planted_effect: L2 layout, blocks 13 and 27, multiples 1, 2, 4, 8 of the mean ||h||; gate at block 27 (as the v1 TV revision)
technical_validation.determinism: L2 baseline repeated within the job (bitwise); L2 and L1 digests compared across the two hosts by the projection node
technical_validation.fragility_on_V: 16 random directions at 0.1/0.25/0.5 x ||t_nonce|| with both signs; per statistic rho = sqrt(max(0, mean(d)^2 - s_d^2/n) x 300 + s_d^2) / s_x; median and max reported, descriptive only
technical_validation.seconds: L2: per-condition suffix+continuation time plus the prefix time divided by the planned L2 shard size; own_prefix: all-position rows in L1; L1_reference: last-position rows in L1; extraction: 64 default-context extraction forwards
technical_validation.overhead_factor: (process start to model ready + real-model self-test + two sentinels + dry-shard compute + publication hashing) / dry-shard compute, for one planned L2 shard (conditions x 300 prompt evaluations); excludes container start and scheduling, which the 0.8 x cap reserve covers
technical_validation.projection: seconds and overhead factor are the maxima over the two hosts; P from the plan; ladder values for the pre-specified reductions are reported

identity.pinned: configs/validation/cts_stage0_v2.yaml execution block (the v1 TV identity); updated by an engineering change if the 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-01 maintenance changes the driver or image, before TV-v2
identity.venv: condor-<16 hex of sha256(condor/requirements-condor.txt)> with a matching .complete marker, or no venv
